title: Cheap-group measurement B summary

comparison_scope.reason: These are not a same-work comparison. Historical v2 is the earlier baseline measurement and its exit rows contain nonzero q/J/geometry-bad cells; P6c then completed the ordered two-adaptation workflow, and current B physically validates a payload-identical replay of P6c.

historical_v2.method: guaranteed epoch-bracket samples only; group shares are sample-weighted, not wall wait/slow-rank causality
limitations: Sample shares describe sampled on-CPU time, not wall wait or slowest-rank causal attribution.
For epoch bracket [L,U], only samples in [U+t0,L+t1) are assigned to phase [t0,t1).
Samples in possible engine time but outside guaranteed intervals are boundary-ambiguous and excluded.
Split-lane gaps and ownership staging/commit gaps are transitions, not pure repartition phases.
Partition DETAIL totals remain separate and are not mapped onto sample phases.
Counts under 100 are marked not resolved; DSO-aware MPI classification comes from summarize_samples.group.

new_B.external_peak_scope: Each per-rank GNUtime record encloses its native child plus recorder/GDB descendants. Sum of largest descendant peaks conservatively bounds the sum of native rank peaks; this is not sampled RSS or a measured native-only sum.

timing_conventions.NATIVE3D_rank_total: whole CNativeRemesher3D::Remesh duration (stats.total_seconds from parent.seconds()-start); this is the 5400s gate.
timing_conventions.NATIVE3D_DETAIL_refine_total: nested Refine-stage duration; reported independently and also bounded by 5400s.
timing_conventions.attribution: rank summary is the whole-event timing; refine detail is a nested component, not additive. Both are checked, not summed.

P6c_full_workflow_receipt.validation_scope: Read-only rank.0 stdout, all isolated rank exit rows, actual mesh, transfer and continued-CFD checks adapted from validate_m6293_completion.py; no isolated disk-restart campaign claimed.

observer_note: Per parent instruction: optional observer tool terminated with exit 143 mid-event 2.
